text:
Alex Rivera: taking the 18:00->02:00 shift tonight. leaving a short watchlist and a couple of small ops actions.
Priya Nair: thanks alex — quick q: any ongoing noisy alerts I should know about?
Alex Rivera: yes, two things: 1) kv-cache pod flapping intermittently on eu-west; 2) prefetch alert (high tail latency) has been spiking during small bursts. neither are full incidents but noisy.
Jon Chen: saw the kv flapping earlier, looks like OOM restarts on a few workers. i bumped request mem from 6Gi->8Gi in the staging nodepool and it stabilized. planning to mirror to eu-west-canary later. :thumbsup:
Alex Rivera: filing that to runbook task: `increase-kvworker-requests`. not doing a global rollout without canary.
Laura Kim: for prefetch latency, metric shows 95p token latency jump when batch size > 8. i left a suggestion in the console to lower max_batch to 6 for route `/generate/prefetch`.
Priya Nair: do we want to silence the alert temporarily? it's generating pages and noise.
Alex Rivera: set suppression on the alert for 2h for eu-west yesterday; i'll enable suppression again for tonight for 4h while we monitor canary.
oncall-bot: Alert suppression enabled: `prefetch-tail-latency` scope=eu-west duration=4h by Alex Rivera
Jon Chen: small FYI — there's a prometheus scrape gap on node-exporter for one host (host-42) at 17:12, likely noisy network hiccup. not seeing missing data after 17:20.
Laura Kim: noted. i'll add host-42 to the maintenance watch so we don't get duplicate alerts during the swap.
Alex Rivera: logs snippet from kv-worker just before restart:```
2029-03-12T17:08:21Z WARN memory_pressure=high free=512MB
2029-03-12T17:08:24Z ERROR OOMKilled process=kv_worker main.go:273
```
Priya Nair: thanks — can you add that to the slack thread task list? i'll pick up the postmortem if it reoccurs.
Alex Rivera: done — created ticket INF-2789 with log snippet and the canary plan.
Jon Chen: i'm going to run the canary rollout for kv-worker in eu-west-canary now: `kubectl -n inference set resources deploy/kv-worker --requests=memory=8Gi` then watch pods. will report back.
Alex Rivera: :eyes: ping when stable. also watch prefix-cache hitrate (metric `cache.prefix.hitrate`) — if it drops >5% after rollout, rollback.
oncall-bot: Deployment event: kv-worker rollout started by Jon Chen at 17:45 UTC
Jon Chen: canary pods up and healthy after 3 restarts, hitrate steady at 99% now. no OOMs for 12m.
Laura Kim: i'm keeping an eye on alert noise channel. if prefetch spikes again i'll reduce max_batch earlier.
Priya Nair: leaving note for the overnight oncall: if you see repeated pager noise for prefetch, escalate to runtime team. otherwise ack in the channel and keep suppression until 02:00.
Alex Rivera: swapping with @Priya at 22:00 — she'll cover remaining hour. handover checklist: tickets assigned, suppression active, canary in progress, watchlist: kv-worker OOM, prefetch tail latency, prometheus scrape gap host-42.
Priya Nair: taking over at 22:00. thanks for the notes. :raised_hands:
Alex Rivera: thanks all — i'll check in at 23:30 for a quick update before I sign off.
Jon Chen: thx, i'll keep monitoring.
noncall-bot: Reminder: nightly snapshot starts 23:50 UTC (no changes expected)
